name: @wildflowerhealthio/positioned-text-web
description: The browser (non-React) extraction seam of the file-formats slice: `extractPositionedText` turns a PDF's raw bytes into a `Document.Type` via a dynamically imported `pdfjs-dist`, and `positionedTextExtractorPdfjs` provides positioned-text's `PositionedTextExtractor` service with it. The PDF anonymizer calls the function; a host running an import provides the layer. Untested by design — everything downstream is tested on hand-written fixture documents.
